paite: Huaiziak in ka unau it leh ngaih, ka kipahna leh ka lallukhute aw, Toupa ah kiptak in dingh un, ka itte aw.
heading: Thuhilhna

paite: Toupa a lungsim kibang pu ding in Euodia ka thuhilh a, Sintikhe ka thuhilh hi.
Ahi, nou leng ka hon ngen ahi, hakkol puakpih muanhuaite, tanchinhoih a ka na seppih hiai numeite, Klemen leh ka naseppih dangte hinna bu a min tuangte leng na panpih un.
Toupa ah kipak gige un; ka chi nawn ding hi kipak un.
Na migitna uh mi tengteng kiang ah kithei hen, Toupa anai hi.
Bangmah lou ah mangbang kei un; himahleh thil bangkim ah, thumna leh ngetna, kipahthu genna toh na ngetnate uh Pathian kiang ah theihsak in om hen.
Huchi in Pathian muanna, lungsim himhim a theih zoh vual louh in Khrist Jesu ah na lungtang leh na ngaihtuahnate uh ahon kepsak ngeingei ding hi.

Atawp pen in unaute aw, thil dik peuhmah, thil phathuai peuhmah, thil kilawm peuhmah, thil siangthou peuhmah, thil hoih peuhmah, thil minhoih peuhmah, hoihna himhim a-om a, phatna ding a-omleh huai thilte ngaihtuah un.
Kei a pan na zilkhiakte, tante, zakte leh na muhte uh, huai thilte hih un. Huchi in muanna Pathian na kiang uah a-om ding hi.
Himahleh nakpitak in Toupa ah ka kipak hi, huchi a tua kei na hon awlmohna uh athak nawn ziak in; na hon limsak mahmah ua, himahleh hun kizen na nei kei ua ahi.
heading: Philippite Tung A Paul Kipahna

paite: Taksap ziak a hiai thu gen ka hi kei; bangchibang in om mah leng huai a lungkim a omdan ka theikheta hi.
Zawndan ka siam a, hauhdan leng ka siam, mun chih leh thil tengteng a gilvah leh gilkial a omtheihna leh niang leh tasam a omtheihna thuguk ka theikheta hi.
Ahon hihhatpa Khrist ah thil tengteng ka hihthei hi.
Huchi a ka mangbatna a na hon panpih ziak un na hihhoih mahmah uhi.
Nou mahmah, nou Philippite ngei in leng tanchinhoih om tung a kipat, Masidonia gam a kipan a ka pai nung, nou chih louh saptuam dang kuamah in piak leh muh lam ah ahon pe kei uh chih na thei uhi.
Thessalonika ah ka taksap awng na hon huksakta uhi.
Thilpiak ka zon ziak ahi kei a, nou a ding a gahpung zong ka hi zaw hi.
Ahimhim in thil bangkim ka nei a, ka hau a; hihdim in ka om a, noumau a pan bangbang hiam, gimnamtui, kithoihna hoih, Pathian kipaksak, Epaphroditas a kipan in ka na mu hi.
Huai chiang in ka Pathian in Khrist Jesu thupina ahauhna bang in na taksap tengteng uh ahon pe ngeingei ding hi. hi.
Tu in Pathian leh i Pa uh kiang ah tangtawn, tangtawn in thupina om hen, Amen.
Khrist Jesu a misiangthou tengteng chibai hon buksak un. Ka kiang a unau omte'n leng chibai ahon buk uhi.
heading: Chibai Bukna Nanung

paite: Misiangthou tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi, Kaisar inkuanpihte ahi deuh tuam uhi.
Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna in hon ompih hen, Amen.
